code.help: The technical code of this payment method.

primary_payment_method_id.help:
The primary payment method of the current payment method, if the latter is a brand.
For example, "Card" is the primary payment method of the card brand "VISA".

brand_ids.help: The brands of the payment methods that will be displayed on the payment form.

provider_ids.help: The list of providers supporting this payment method.

image.help: The base image used for this payment method; in a 64x64 px format.

image_payment_form.help: The base image used for this payment method; in a 64x64 px format.
image_payment_form.string: The resized image displayed on the payment form.

support_tokenization.help: Tokenization is the process of saving the payment details as a token that can later be reused without having to enter the payment details again.

support_express_checkout.help: Express checkout allows customers to pay faster by using a payment method that provides all required billing and shipping information, thus allowing to skip the checkout process.

support_manual_capture.help: The payment is authorized and captured in two steps instead of one.

support_refund.help: Refund is a feature allowing to refund customers directly from the payment in Odoo.

supported_country_ids.help: The list of countries in which this payment method can be used (if the provider allows it). In other countries, this payment method is not available to customers.

supported_currency_ids.help: The list of currencies for that are supported by this payment method (if the provider allows it). When paying with another currency, this payment method is not available to customers.
